description: Subscribe a consumer to an EMAIL rate alert: notify them when the live market meets their target (rate/apr/monthly_payment crossing a threshold). Consent-first — sends a double-opt-in confirmation email; the alert only activates after the recipient confirms. One-click unsubscribe in every email (CAN-SPAM). Stores only email + alert criteria. Provide exactly one of state, states, or region.

email.description: Consumer email address to send the alert to. Required.

region.description: Named region preset (e.g. east_coast); expands server-side to its member states.

state.description: Legacy single US state code (2-letter, e.g., CA, TX, NY). Prefer states or region for multi-state alerts.

states.description: 2-letter US state codes (up to 25) — best rates are ranked ACROSS all of them, not per state.

target.description: The condition that triggers the alert. Required.

operator.description: Comparison operator (lte=at or below, gte=at or above).

value.description: The threshold value to compare against.

name: subscribe_rate_alert

outputSchema.description: Result of a double-opt-in rate-alert subscription. The alert is created in 'pending' status and only becomes active once the borrower clicks the confirmation email.

assumed_defaults.description: Loan assumptions recorded with the alert; null where the caller supplied none.

amount.description: Loan amount used when evaluating the threshold.

disclosures.description: Consent and CAN-SPAM disclosures for the subscription.

message.description: Human-readable next step ('Check your inbox to confirm').

region_preset.description: Region preset key when one was used, else null.

state.description: Legacy scalar state — the first entry of `states`.

states.description: Full list of watched state codes. Regions are expanded to a fixed snapshot at subscribe time.

target.description: The threshold that fires the alert.
